**Publish gate report: landing hero**

**Going out:** Landing page hero copy, Pebblebrook Tea Co. website, UK audience.

**Claims check**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "you'll love it or it's free" | **Blocked.** Policy section 3 bans this exact wording and there is no such offer. |
| "Subscribers can pause or cancel any time" | On the policy list (subscription terms). |
| "free UK delivery on orders over £25" | On the policy list (shipping policy). |
| "most boxes ship free" | **Unproven.** We have no data on what share of orders clear £25. It is an implied statistic. |

**Regulated claims:** This touches prices and offers. The "or it's free" line is a false money-back promise, which is the risky part. Removing it fixes this.

**House style:** No banned words. The tone is fairly warm and plain. The opening "Tea that's easy to stop and start" is a bit awkward, and the sentence is long. I rewrote it for clarity without adding any claims.

**Disclosure:** Our own site copy, so no label is needed.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite)**
- Removed the guarantee.
- Removed "most boxes ship free".
- Kept the two allowed claims, worded as in the policy.

> Tea on your terms. Pause or cancel your subscription any time, and enjoy free UK delivery on orders over £25.

**Needs a decision:** None, if you accept the rewrite. If the team actually wants a satisfaction guarantee, that needs a real offer with terms added to the policy first.

**Approver:** Sam (marketing lead). The draft as submitted should not go out. The rewrite needs Sam's explicit yes to that exact text before publishing.
